description: This file contains the implementation of the TreeInterpreter class, which evaluates JMESPath AST expressions by traversing the abstract syntax tree (AST). It handles different node types such as 'field', 'subexpression', 'projection', 'literal', logical operations, functions, and more, to interpret queries against data structures.

classes.name: TreeInterpreter
classes.description: Class responsible for interpreting and evaluating JMESPath AST expressions by traversing the tree nodes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dispatcher callback, defaulting to FnDispatcher::getInstance() if none provided.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Entry point for evaluating a node against data, dispatching processing to the internal dispatch method.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Recursively traverses each node in the AST, applying logic based on node type to evaluate or transform data accordingly.
